status: Root static art approved. Cloud-only draft; NOT integrated or runtime verified. No publication or technical dispatch authorized.

energy_plus.style: Standalone solid rounded goldplus only. No external blue/gold square base. Reuse existing energy pill unchanged.
energy_plus.hit_target: Existing48dp invisible hit target may remain; it must not enlarge/draw a visual frame.

cloth_order_hint.arrangement: Vertical: neutral white-frame/navy ordercard containing gray-white sealed bottle, then dynamic remaining number. No specific color target, video icon or adlock.
cloth_order_hint.card_anchor: Centered horizontally on cloth; about25dp below bottle top in current41x102 QA. Count centered beneath with2–4dp gap. Do not enlarge whole bottle to fit hint.
cloth_order_hint.short_text_rule: Show only if allocated cell width fits at>=11dp font without overlaps. Otherwise icon+number only, with first-use hint. Never shrink text to unreadable size.
cloth_order_hint.first_hint_zh: 完成任意订单后揭开遮布
cloth_order_hint.first_hint_en: Complete any order to reveal this bottle.
cloth_order_hint.remaining_binding: Read authoritative existing remaining-order count, not baked sample1. Forplural firsthint use actual remaining count where needed.
cloth_order_hint.decrement_rule: Only an actual accepted/received matching order completion in the existing order logic decrements the remaining count, exactly once. A full same-color bottle being corked but not matched/received is NOT order completion. Do not decrement on corking, transient flight start, refresh, locale change or duplicate callbacks.
cloth_order_hint.unlock_rule: Existing authoritative hidden/unlock state decides reveal. This art changes no rules, color ids, thresholds, timers or ad entitlements.

compatibility: Use with reference3_cartoon_bottle_v1 cloth/render-mask binding. All overlays/counts separate from cloth image. No production code included.
